Global Metadata
Modern Mandopop love ballad with Chinese-style pop elements, performed in Mandarin and shaped for a four-minute arc. Use a slow-to-moderate, flowing tempo with gentle emotional motion: intimate longing in the opening, warmth and resolve in the choruses, then a quiet, lingering close. Blend acoustic piano, guzheng, pipa ornamentation, breathy dizi, soft strings, and restrained modern ambient pads. Keep the production spacious, warm, and organic; avoid heavy beats or dense electronic drops.
Vocal Details
One solo female Mandarin vocalist with a soft, clear, airy tone. Verses should feel close and conversational, using smooth legato phrasing and delicate breath at line endings. Let the choruses open into a fuller, more resonant register while staying lyrical rather than forceful. Use only subtle self-harmony in the final chorus; add light hall reverb and a very short delay for depth.
Arrangement
[Intro] 0:00–0:10
Pure instrumental, 10 seconds. Begin with a very soft breathy dizi sustained tone, followed by sparse guzheng plucks introducing the main melodic motif. Add a distant, subtle wind-like ambient texture. No drums and no vocals. Keep the opening spacious, quiet, and ethereal, leaving plenty of room for the female vocal entrance.

[Verse] 0:10–0:50
Slow, spacious piano arpeggios form the harmonic foundation, with sparse guzheng responses appearing mainly at the ends of vocal phrases. The female vocal should feel intimate, soft, airy, and close to the listener. Use smooth legato lines, long sustained notes, natural breaths, and brief pauses between phrases. Avoid dense or rapid lyrical delivery.

[Pre-Chorus] 0:50–1:10
Build emotion through harmonic warmth rather than strong anticipation. Introduce low sustained strings and very subtle pipa ornaments. Add only minimal soft percussion as a gentle pulse, without creating a heavy rhythmic push. The female vocal gradually opens into a slightly wider register while remaining delicate and restrained. Let the final phrase stretch naturally and create a feeling of reaching across the night.

[Chorus] 1:10–1:42
Expand into a fuller emotional texture with richer piano chords, soft wide strings, delicate pipa accents, and a sustained dizi counter-melody. The female vocal becomes warmer, fuller, and more resonant while remaining lyrical and graceful rather than powerful. Leave noticeable breathing space around each repeated “Longing” phrase so the melody remains memorable and emotionally open.

[Post-Chorus] 1:42–1:52
Pure instrumental, 10 seconds. Guzheng echoes fragments of the chorus melody while dizi responds gently in the upper register. Add a soft natural reverb tail and faint atmospheric ambience. Do not introduce a new rhythm. Let the music gradually settle before returning to the second verse.

[Verse] 1:52–2:30
Reduce the arrangement again. Keep piano and guzheng as the main elements, with occasional delicate pipa ornaments creating slightly more melodic movement than in the first verse. The female vocal remains slow, intimate, and breathy. Emphasize imagery and emotional phrasing, allowing the final words of each line to linger naturally.

[Pre-Chorus] 2:30–2:50
Gradually widen the emotional space with low-to-high sustained strings. Add an extremely subtle cymbal swell and airy dizi texture while the piano slowly develops richer harmonic movement. Avoid a dramatic build. Leave a brief breathing gap immediately before the second chorus so the final line of the section can naturally suspend in the air.

[Chorus] 2:50–3:22
Create the fullest arrangement of the song. Wide cinematic strings, warm piano, guzheng, pipa, and dizi blend into an elegant modern Chinese-pop sound. The female vocal should be more resonant and emotionally open than the first chorus, using longer melodic phrases and controlled intensity. Avoid aggressive belting or overly dramatic high notes. Let the final phrase sustain and gradually soften.

[Bridge] 3:22–3:40
Suddenly strip the arrangement back to piano, very sparse guzheng, and solo female vocal. Increase the sense of space and intimacy. The vocal should become almost conversational, with longer pauses between phrases. After the phrase “And I am still here,” leave a noticeable silence before the final lyric, creating a suspended, reflective moment.

[Solo] 3:40–3:50
Pure instrumental solo, 10 seconds. Let guzheng carry the main melody, with dizi providing a soft answering line. Keep piano on simple warm chords while strings remain barely audible as sustained atmospheric tones. The solo should continue the central “longing” motif without virtuoso playing. Focus on tenderness, solitude, and unfinished affection.

[Outro] 3:50–4:00
Pure instrumental, 10 seconds. No vocals. Piano plays the final warm chord with a slightly unresolved emotional quality, followed by two or three delicate guzheng notes. Dizi sustains one final breathy tone that slowly dissolves into silence. No drums, no dramatic ending hit, and no abrupt stop. Fade out naturally.
[Intro]
（纯音乐）

[Verse 1]
月落在窗前
风轻过眉间
你走以后
夜色又深了一点

我捧一盏灯
等天亮以前
把没说完的话
藏进云水之间

[Pre-Chorus]
若山高水远
隔不断思念
我便把心事
写成一缕月光
越过长夜
落在你身旁

[Chorus]
长相思
入梦几回
明明只隔一轮月
却像隔了人间

长相思
落在眉间
我不问归期有多远
只愿你也曾想念

[Post-Chorus]
风吹散花影
月照旧庭院
一声轻叹
落入无人听见的夜

[Verse 2]
雨落在窗前
琴声慢了一些
那些旧梦
还温柔停在昨天

我轻轻念你
没有惊动月
让所有遗憾
随晚风慢慢沉淀

[Pre-Chorus]
若聚散无言
缘分自有深浅
我愿将余生
守着这一份温柔
不问岁月
只念你眉眼

[Chorus]
长相思
入梦几回
明明只隔一轮月
却像隔了人间

长相思
落在眉间
纵然此生山水遥远
我仍把你放在心间

[Bridge]
若有一天
你也经过那片月色
请替我看看
当年的花
是否还开着

而我仍在
最初相遇的风里面
轻轻唱着
没有唱完的思念

[Solo]
（无歌词，古筝与笛子主旋律，钢琴和弦与柔和弦乐铺底）

[Outro]
（纯音乐，无人声）
